answer: That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. The desk only stamps a name that carries Recognised farrier court bond, and the stamp itself rests on a bond farriers post after shoe trials. The forge is that the bill for trying is a toll of 38 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, due at the door for every name. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. One quartz, one entry. Every signal is counted once.
